interactions.description: marketplace discovery and install-intent prototype fixture

providerStates.name: HOBO-562 marketplace discovery prototype is available

catalog.trustEvidence: Publisher identity exists but review, conformance, and org catalog evidence are incomplete.
catalog.orgCatalogDecision: Not eligible for org catalog selection until review evidence is accepted.
catalog.installabilityOutcome: Warning-only discovery; install intent is hidden.
catalog.customerSafeMessage: Preview listing is visible for evaluation and cannot be presented as installable.
catalog.safeNextAction: Open the evidence checklist before planning any use.

catalog.trustEvidence: Limited beta approval is visible but still bounded by missing-evidence language.
catalog.orgCatalogDecision: Visible only to approved beta workspaces with policy pin and owner route.
catalog.installabilityOutcome: Install intent is scoped to beta fixtures and must keep missing-evidence copy.
catalog.customerSafeMessage: Limited-beta listing is available only to allowed scopes with explicit limits.
catalog.safeNextAction: Confirm beta workspace eligibility and owner route before showing install intent.

catalog.trustEvidence: Provenance, conformance, security review, org catalog, and policy evidence are linked.
catalog.orgCatalogDecision: Approved for the recorded workspace with immutable version pin and support owner.
catalog.installabilityOutcome: Install intent may be shown because every required evidence field is present.
catalog.customerSafeMessage: Listing is installable for the recorded workspace because required evidence is linked.
catalog.safeNextAction: Show install intent with evidence links, owner route, and proof-mode chip.

catalog.trustEvidence: Catalog or mandatory policy denies this scope even though listing metadata remains visible.
catalog.orgCatalogDecision: Blocked for current workspace; no install intent or override is exposed.
catalog.installabilityOutcome: Install intent is suppressed and user sees the catalog/policy owner.
catalog.customerSafeMessage: Listing is blocked for this org or workspace by catalog, policy, trust, or approval state.
catalog.safeNextAction: Route the user to catalog owner evidence without granting override.

catalog.trustEvidence: Deprecation notice and replacement evidence exist, but current installability is stale.
catalog.orgCatalogDecision: Visible for existing-use and migration guidance; not a default new selection.
catalog.installabilityOutcome: Install intent becomes guidance-only with migration or replacement next action.
catalog.customerSafeMessage: Deprecated listing remains visible only for existing-use and migration guidance.
catalog.safeNextAction: Show replacement or migration guidance and preserve stale-evidence label.

catalog.trustEvidence: Yank decision is recorded; production registry removal remains outside this proof.
catalog.orgCatalogDecision: Removed from new selection and retained only for audit/support explanation.
catalog.installabilityOutcome: Install intent is denied and the only visible route is support or migration.
catalog.customerSafeMessage: Yanked listing is unavailable for new use and routes to support or migration guidance.
catalog.safeNextAction: Show customer-safe support route without creating live tickets.

paths.expectedUserSignal: Installable listing shows evidence, owner route, org-catalog approval, and proof mode.
paths.supportHandoff: Capability review owner remains visible for evidence questions.

paths.expectedUserSignal: Blocked and yanked listings suppress install intent and expose owner routes.
paths.supportHandoff: Org Catalogs or Support Workflow receives a customer-safe handoff.

paths.expectedUserSignal: Preview, beta, and deprecated states keep missing or stale evidence visible.
paths.supportHandoff: Marketplace trust, capability review, or registry distribution owner remains named.

paths.expectedUserSignal: Support handoff is visible without implying support automation exists.
paths.supportHandoff: Support Workflow receives redacted customer-safe context only.

accessibilityNotes: Keyboard order reaches listing state, evidence, org-catalog decision, support route, proof mode, and safe action.
Screen reader text includes listing state, installability outcome, proof mode, and source fixture id.
Contrast and copy distinguish approved, preview, limited beta, policy-blocked, deprecated, and yanked states.
Responsive layout keeps support route, customer-safe message, and proof mode adjacent on narrow screens.
Reduced-motion variants preserve blocked and stale-evidence state changes without animation-only meaning.
scopeOut: No live storefront, browse/search service, marketplace service, or production UI.
No Registry storage, registry resolver, package hosting, signing, or install-time verification.
No install runtime, install service, deploy runtime, or live provider action.
No ranking, recommendation, paid placement, monetization, payouts, or marketplace commerce policy.
No publisher workflow, publisher portal UI, evidence upload service, or maintainer workflow.
No policy engine, RBAC runtime, scanner integration, conformance runner, or approval service.
No support queue, support tooling, notification delivery, or live ticket creation.
No public launch publication or launch claims without evidence.
